author: swain
title: Drop the campaign.ai_content column and the ai_chat table
body:
> [!WARNING]
> **Do not merge until BOTH of these are merged AND deployed to prod:**
> - #3747 (removes every gp-api reader and writer of `Campaign.aiContent` and `AiChat`). Merged to `main`; wait until the release train has shipped it to prod.
> - thegoodparty/gp-data-platform#1353 (stops dbt selecting `campaign.ai_content`).
>
> gp-api migrates on deploy. If this lands first, prod code that still touches the column or table breaks, and the dbt staging model for `campaign` fails along with everything downstream of it.

The legacy campaign AI chat and the `aiContent` generator have been dead since July 2026. #3747 removed the code and left the schema alone so it could ship without a destructive migration. This is the last step of that cleanup: drop the data the removed code left behind.

The data is intentionally not exported. Swain approved dropping both without a backup.

The migration was generated with `prisma migrate dev --create-only`, and `prisma migrate diff` against a fresh shadow DB reports no drift. It is exactly:

```sql
-- DropForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "ai_chat" DROP CONSTRAINT "ai_chat_campaign_id_fkey";

-- DropForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "ai_chat" DROP CONSTRAINT "ai_chat_user_id_fkey";

-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "campaign" DROP COLUMN "ai_content";

-- DropTable
DROP TABLE "ai_chat";
```

Dropping the table also drops its indexes (`ai_chat_thread_id_key`, `ai_chat_thread_id_idx`, `ai_chat_user_id_campaign_id_idx`).

+*/
+-- DropForeignKey

+-- DropForeignKey
+ALTER TABLE "ai_chat" DROP CONSTRAINT "ai_chat_user_id_fkey";
+
+-- AlterTable
+ALTER TABLE "campaign" DROP COLUMN "ai_content";
+
+-- DropTable
+DROP TABLE "ai_chat";
